player_prompt.intro:
Ngwe wena Mdlali {player_id} ku Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Isikhala sakho si '{symbol}', futhi inombolo yakho yekunyakaza njalo {parity} (isib. X1, X3 noma O2, O4).

Inhloso: Wina ngokwakha mstari wemariki e-classical e-mathathu (ezisolidified ukusuka kwisuperpositions).

Indlela yokudlala:
- Kusukela kwenye iladi, beka isikhala sesipokisi kwenye amasquare amabili ahlukeneyo asempty usebenzisa ifomethi '[a,b]'.
- Lezi zisikhala zipokisi zinahlanganiswe, futhi zibhalwe njengesi 'X1 / X1' noma 'O4 / O4'.
- Awunakwazi ukubeka izisikhala zesipokisi kwenye isquare esisolidified.

Umthetho wokwehluka:
- Uma kunyakaza kwakho kukhulisa ingxenye kwenye grafu yehlanganiswe, ikwehluka ngokwakhe.
- Isikhala sesipokisi kwenye ingxenye isihlala sisikhala sesiclassical kwenye indawo yayo yedwa.
- Izisikhala zesipokisi ezihlanganiswe nazo zikwehluka.

Uwina:
- Umidlalo uphela lapho mdlali unemariki e-classical e-mathathu mstari.
- Uma abadlali babili banomstari ngokwehluka kwakhe, owayenombolo yekunyakaza e-ndlini yemenziwe inqaba.

Isibonelo sokunyakaza: '[0,4]' ibeka isikhala sesipokisi kwenye amasquare 0 na 4.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Ema-index etinhlayiya langasebenti nobe laphindvwe kabili.

game_action.placed: Mdlali {player_id} wathatha isithombe sakhe kwenqwaba elinganiselwe kwizindawo {pos_a} na {pos_b}.

game_message.last_cell_resolved: Inqwaba elinganiselwe yeceli elingapheli ihlelwe. Iceli ({r}, {c}) manje {symbol}.
